mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and decrease in FEDFUNDS indicates monetary policy response to inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1200.0) signals weakening demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates economic slowdown, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising CPIAUCSL combined with stable FEDFUNDS signals persistent inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable during monetary tightening, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
